title: AI Futures Project proposes data center safety plans to #AIFuturesProject #PlanA #AIregulation
description: The AI Futures Project proposed a strategy called Plan A to prevent catastrophic outcomes from superintelligent AI development. Their plan involves placing critical AI data centers on rival nations’ soil with no defenses, enabling mutually assured compute destruction to deter any AI arms race escalation. It stresses full transparency in AI research to detect cheating and promotes a cooperative slowdown of AI progress, aiming to delay superintelligence until around 2040. This approach draws parallels to Cold War nuclear deterrence, applying those principles to AI governance to avoid risks such as human extinction or global dictatorship. The proposal reflects growing concern over AI’s rapid advancement and the absence of robust international frameworks to manage it safely. By introducing trust-building mechanisms between the US and China, Plan A suggests a path forward to responsibly shape the future of AI technology and minimize existential threats. The report highlights the urgency of creating concrete, enforceable AI agreements and calls attention to a significant risk window in the coming decade. Its recommendations invite policymakers, researchers, and global leaders to rethink AI competition dynamics and prioritize collective safety over unilateral advantage. #AIFuturesProject #PlanA #Superintelligence #AI2027 #MutuallyAssuredComputeDestruction #AIResearchTransparency #USChinaAI #AISafety #ArtificialIntelligence #AISecurity #AIArmsRace #FutureOfAI #AIRegulation #TechPolicy #GlobalAIGovernance
